verified_key_information_units.information: Headline financial performance showing net sales decreased to SEK 295M (from SEK 352M in 2024) with EBITDA of SEK 17M (third consecutive positive year but down from SEK 47M), EBIT loss of SEK 40M (compared to SEK 4M loss in 2024), and operating cash flow turning negative at SEK -73M (from SEK 57M in 2024), while cash reserves declined to SEK 30M.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Financial highlights table (page 5), Consolidated Statement of Comprehensive Income (page 33), Consolidated Balance Sheet (page 34), Consolidated Statement of Cash Flows (page 36)

candidate_sentences.text: Net sales decreased by 16 percent to SEK 295.3 million, down from SEK 352.9 million in 2024.
EBITDA fell significantly to SEK 17.5 million from SEK 46.7 million in 2024.
The operating result after depreciation and impairment was a loss of SEK 40.0 million, compared to a loss of SEK 4.0 million in 2024.

Operating cash flow also deteriorated, moving from a positive SEK 56.8 million in 2024 to a negative SEK 72.6 million in 2025, largely due to the timing of revenue recognition and working capital changes associated with project delays.

details.completeness_justification: K1, K2, K4, K6 and K7 are fully represented. K3 and K5 are only partially covered because the candidate omits the SEK 350M co-funded programme size, 50% UK Space Agency contribution, the SEK 11.8M EPS-Sterna order value, and the SEK 140M total Bonnier Capital commitment with its SEK 50.3M initial tranche. K8 is entirely absent as no post-period events are mentioned.
details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is internally coherent. Each sentence follows logically from the preceding ones: the opening statement of decline (S1) is supported by the quantified sales drop (S2) and its attributed cause (S3–S4); the contrasting growth in Data & Services (S5–S6) is presented as an offset rather than a contradiction; profitability and cash-flow deterioration (S7–S11) are explicitly linked to the same delays and investment activities; subsequent business developments (S12–S14) and financing actions (S15–S16) are presented as responses to the operational context; and the closing remarks on equity ratio, backlog and strategy (S17–S19) logically conclude the narrative without introducing conflicting claims or circular reasoning. No sentence negates or undermines another, and the overall structure moves from financial results to operational context to forward-looking statements in a clear sequence.
